text:
kayla: Heads-up from staging: our onboarding sampleapp ended up inserting duplicate rows when a 429 happened during token rotation. Not user-facing but noisy in DB :grimace:

sam: yikes. can you share the minimal repro and the client retry config?

kayla: repro: boot sampleapp -> hammer embeddings endpoint with 100 concurrent requests -> wait for scheduled token rotation -> some requests hit 429 -> client retried and duplicate insert observed. copied trace: request-id abc123 appeared twice in app logs.

ingrid: what's the retry policy in the app? immediate retries + no jitter are classic footguns.

kayla: current sampleapp config:
```js
retries: 3,
baseBackoffMs: 100,
jitter: 0, // disabled for determinism in demo
enableSafeReplay: false,
```
sam: that explains it. jitter=0 + token rotation aligned retries = same external side-effect replayed. safeReplay false means SDK won't prevent duplicate side effects.

maya: proposal: update quickstart template to enable safe replay and sensible jitter. Also add an onboarding lint/warn that detects "unsafe" retry configs when token rotation or auto-refresh is enabled.

kayla: ran a quick experiment: change to jitter uniform(100,600) + enableSafeReplay true. ran 1k bursts, zero duplicates. will add e2e that simulates token rotate + transient 429s.

alex: if we change defaults we must keep parity across SDKs (node/go/python). IIRC node sampleapp had safeReplay off historically for easier demos. i'll own the parity ticket.

ingrid: recommended defaults for sampleapps and quickstart docs we can adopt now:
- retries: 4
- baseBackoffMs: 150
- jitter: 100-600 (randomized)
- enableSafeReplay: true
Also show usage of an Idempotency-Key header for user-visible side effects:
```http
POST /v1/actions
Idempotency-Key: <uuid-v4>
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

sam: also add explicit guidance: "Do not rely on automatic retries for operations that mutate external systems unless you provide idempotency keys or the SDK safe replay guard is enabled." Short blurb in quickstart.

kayla: i'll open a PR that updates sampleapp config, adds the e2e test (simulate rotation + 429s), and a small telemetry check that surfaces an onboarding warning: "Retry settings may lead to duplicate side effects during token refresh". opt-out for private installs.

maya: +1. make the telemetry check non-blocking but visible in console and quickstart logs.

devbot: Checklist created for PR: sampleapp config change, docs update, parity tickets for SDKs, and e2e CI job. See internal link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1234 :white_check_mark:

alex: ping me when PR is up. i'll route the parity ticket and update SDK templates. suggest also adding a small snippet in SDK README for safeReplay and idempotency best practices.

kayla: thanks — updating now. i'll post CI results back here. :thumbsup:
